page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.2xlarge is an x86_64 server instance running on KVM hypervisor technology. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, offering 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs through hyperthreading. The hardware configuration includes 33 MB of L3 cache, 64 GB of RAM yielding 8 GB per core, and a bundled 1919 GB SSD for local storage. Baseline network bandwidth is capped at 2 Gbps, and no GPU hardware acceleration is present.

Performance testing indicates mid-tier caching capabilities paired with lower-tier raw compute throughput. The instance scored 7005.33 on the PassMark CPU test and achieved 6.02 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmark operations. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance benchmarks in stress-ng reached 1101.68 and 5868.18 respectively, placing raw compute speed in the lower quartile. Large-block memory read bandwidth measured 39.32 GB/sec, while static web serving throughput reached 4.54 GB/sec.

Given its combination of 64 GB of RAM and 1919 GB of local SSD capacity alongside modest CPU benchmark scores, the instance offers a storage-dense resource profile. It is positioned for storage-heavy tasks, local database deployments, and caching servers where substantial local disk space and memory footprint take priority over intensive processor performance.
